summary: Nurix Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting a license and collaboration agreement with Roche for bexobrutideg. Roche pays $700M upfront, potential milestones up to $2.3B, 40/50% cost-sharing, equal US profit split. This is a strategic licensing deal, not a merger or acquisition; no change of control occurs. The filing is a material agreement but not a special situation. Category is None; deal_terms are not applicable.
